gaps.lead: The exam regulations forbid the use of mobile phones.
He spoke slowly because he wanted us to understand him.
gaps.explanation: so that + subject + would/could expresses purpose.

gaps.lead: Despite his serious injury, he finished the marathon.
I only understood the pattern much later.
gaps.explanation: Front 'only + time phrase' forces inversion: Only much later did I understand.

gaps.lead: I haven't seen a better film this year.
gaps.sentence: This is ___ I've seen this year.
gaps.explanation: I haven't seen a better film = this is the best film (that) I've seen.
it's (high) time + subject + past simple = you should already be doing it.
